## Service 1: PVC Panel Installation

**Short description:** Durable, waterproof wall cladding for every room.

**Full description:** Premium PVC panels that transform your walls with a sleek, modern finish. Waterproof, termite-resistant, and easy to maintain — perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, and living spaces.

**Features:**
- Waterproof & moisture resistant
- 100% termite proof
- Easy installation (1 day vs 3–5 days for tiles)
- Low maintenance
- 100+ designs available (plain, marble, wood, 3D textured, ceiling panels)
- Cost-effective alternative to tiles
- Price range: ₹60–₹180 per sq ft

**Available types:** Plain & Solid Colour PVC Wall Panels · Marble Finish PVC Panels · Wood Texture PVC Panels · 3D Textured PVC Panels · Ceiling PVC Panels · Foam-Core Insulation PVC Panels

**FAQs:**

Q: Why is Shri Shah Home Decor the best PVC panel installer in Uttarakhand?
A: With 10+ years of experience, 500+ completed projects, ISI-certified materials, and free site visits, Shri Shah Home Decor is the most trusted PVC panel installer in the region. We serve Ramnagar, Nainital, Haldwani, Corbett, and all of Uttarakhand.

Q: How much do PVC panels cost in Uttarakhand?
A: PVC panel prices in Uttarakhand typically range from ₹60–₹180 per sq ft depending on the design and brand. Call +91 9548506887 for a free site visit and accurate quote.

Q: Are PVC panels better than tiles for bathrooms?
A: PVC panels install in 1 day vs 3–5 days for tiles, are 100% waterproof, termite-proof, and more affordable. They're ideal for modern bathroom renovations and work well in Uttarakhand's humid climate.

Q: Do you install PVC panels across all of Uttarakhand?
A: Yes. We provide PVC panel installation across Uttarakhand — Ramnagar, Nainital, Haldwani, Corbett, Rudrapur, Kashipur, Almora, Bhimtal, and nearby areas.

Q: How long do PVC panels last?
A: With proper installation, PVC panels can last 10–15 years with minimal maintenance.

## Service 3: False Ceiling

**Short description:** Elegant ceilings — gypsum, POP, grid, and metal types.

**Full description:** Expert false ceiling installation in all types: POP, gypsum board, grid ceiling, metal ceilings, and coffered designs. Improves insulation, acoustics, and aesthetics simultaneously.

**Features:**
- All types: POP, Gypsum, Grid, Metal, Coffered
- LED cove lighting integration
- Recessed panel light installation
- Thermal & acoustic insulation
- Fire-resistant materials
- Custom designs & patterns

**FAQs:**

Q: What types of false ceilings do you offer?
A: POP ceilings, gypsum board ceilings, grid ceilings (T-bar), metal ceilings, and custom coffered designs.

Q: Can you integrate LED lights in the false ceiling?
A: Yes. Specialisation in integrated LED lighting, cove lighting, and recessed panel lights.
